# s405 — Fall back to the next matching row when a role hits a vendor limit

## Why

On 2026-10-26 Codex ran out of credits in the middle of two ork relays (S125 fix round, S127 first round). Nothing in the contract said what to do; the owner picked a Claude row by hand and the partial diffs were finished by it. ork decided (adj 156) to fall back only on a classified limit (rate limit, out of credits) to the role's next matching matrix row, and S133 classifies Codex out-of-credits. `relay-roles recommend` already lists alternatives.
